terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Please read the terms and conditions for using our services carefully. Accessing our website (<site>www.daudtravel.com</site> and its subdomains), booking or purchasing a tour means that you (the Client) fully agree to and accept these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree with any provision, please do not use our services.

general.title: General Provisions
general.p1: By accessing our website (www.daudtravel.com and its subdomains) and using our services, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. Please read them carefully before purchasing or booking a tour.
general.p2: In the event of a violation of these Terms and Conditions, the travel agency has the right to refuse to provide the service or to cancel the booking.

booking.title: Booking and Payment
booking.intro: On our website you can purchase a tour in two ways:
booking.option1Text: Immediate payment of the full price of the tour online by bank card or by another available payment method.
booking.option2Text: Booking a tour by paying an advance. The remaining amount can be paid later in cash or by online bank transaction. The deadline and conditions for paying the remaining amount are specified in the booking confirmation.
booking.p1: All payments are processed through secure payment systems. Once your payment is confirmed, you will receive a confirmation message by email.
booking.p2: In the case of a reservation, if the remaining amount is not paid before the start of the tour, the travel agency has the right to cancel the tour.

tourDetails.title: Tour Description and Details
tourDetails.intro: Detailed information is provided on the website for each tour, including:
tourDetails.item5: Included services (transport, guide, meals, accommodation, etc.)
tourDetails.item6: Price (per person or for the whole group)
tourDetails.outro: Please read all the details carefully before purchasing a tour. Upon purchase, you are deemed to have agreed to the conditions described for the tour.

changes.title: Changes and Modifications
changes.p1: Any change or modification to the tour details is possible only after direct contact with the travel agency.
changes.p2: All changes are subject to availability and may incur additional charges. Changes take effect only after written confirmation from the travel agency.
changes.p3: The travel agency reserves the right, in the event of unforeseen circumstances (weather conditions, safety issues, etc.), to make changes to the tour route or services in order to ensure the safety and comfort of the Client.

cancellation.title: Cancellation and Refunds
cancellation.p1: As a rule, amounts paid are not refunded after the tour has been purchased.
cancellation.p2: However, in exceptional cases the travel agency may consider a refund on an individual basis. Whether a refund is possible, and its amount, depend on:
cancellation.item1: The reason for and circumstances of the cancellation
cancellation.item2: The time remaining before the tour at the moment of cancellation
cancellation.item3: Costs already incurred for organizing the tour
cancellation.item4: The type and specifics of the tour
cancellation.p3: To have a cancellation considered, you must contact the travel agency and submit a written request. The decision is made by the travel agency based on an individual review of each case.
cancellation.p4: If the tour is cancelled for reasons attributable to the travel agency, the Client is offered a full refund or an alternative tour.

clientResponsibility.title: Client Responsibilities
clientResponsibility.item1: Having all documents required for the tour (passport, visa, etc.)
clientResponsibility.item2: Ensuring that their state of health is compatible with the requirements of the tour
clientResponsibility.item3: Preparing the recommended equipment and personal items
clientResponsibility.item4: Following the instructions of the guide and organizers during the tour
clientResponsibility.item6: Respecting other participants and their comfort
clientResponsibility.outro: In the event of inappropriate behavior, violation of safety rules, or disturbance of other participants during the tour, the travel agency has the right to terminate the Client's participation in the tour without a refund.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.intro: The travel agency is not responsible for:
liability.item1: Unforeseen circumstances (natural disasters, pandemics, political crises, etc.)
liability.item2: The Client's personal belongings, or their loss or damage
liability.item3: The consequences of the Client violating safety rules
liability.item4: The quality of third-party services (hotels, restaurants, transport) if it does not meet the stated standards
liability.outro: The travel agency will make every effort to ensure a safe and high-quality service, but does not accept responsibility for unforeseen circumstances.

contact.title: Contact and Support
contact.intro: If you have any questions or problems, or need assistance, please contact our travel agency:
contact.item3: Via the contact form on the website
contact.outro: Our team is ready to help you at every stage of planning, booking and organizing your tour.

changesToTerms.title: Changes to the Terms
changesToTerms.p1: The travel agency reserves the right to change or update these Terms and Conditions at any time. Changes take effect from the moment they are published on the website.
changesToTerms.p2: It is the Client's responsibility to review these Terms and Conditions periodically for updates. Continued use of the website constitutes your acceptance of the updated terms.

language.title: Language
language.p1: These Terms and Conditions are presented in two languages: Georgian and English. In the event of any inaccuracy or discrepancy in the translation, the Georgian version shall prevail.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Please read our Privacy Policy, because by accessing our website (<site>www.daudtravel.com</site> and its subdomains) you (the website user) agree to the provisions set out below. If you do not agree, please leave the website.

collect.title: What Information We Collect
collect.p1: We collect only the information that you yourself provide to us when booking a tour, placing an order and/or performing a similar action.
collect.item2: Mobile phone number (used for direct communication and contact)
collect.paymentText: We do not store your bank card details. Payments are processed through the secure services of an integrated third party (a bank or payment system).

use.title: How We Use the Collected Information
use.intro: We use the collected information to:
use.item1: Receive, process and confirm your order/booking
use.item2: Contact you (by phone or email) about details, changes or other necessary information related to the purchased tour
use.item3: Send you email notifications about a successful booking/purchase and provide the final tour details
use.item4: Improve our website and services so that interacting with us is more convenient for you
use.item5: Where appropriate, inform you about news, special offers and new tours (only with your consent or with the option to unsubscribe)

sharing.title: Disclosure of Information to Third Parties
sharing.intro: We do not voluntarily share information with third parties, except:
sharing.item2: Where necessary to provide the service: limited information (for example, first and last name) may be shared with tour operators, guides or service providers directly involved in carrying out the tour you have purchased. In such cases, only the information necessary for the full provision of the service is shared

other.title: Other Details
other.p1: Our Privacy Policy is presented in two languages: Georgian and English. In the event of any inaccuracy in the translation, the Georgian version shall prevail. If you have any questions regarding the Privacy Policy, please contact us.
